annotations.text:
Target state, not current state.

Every screen extends Todero's real tokens — #080808 ground, #0f0f0f surface, white/10 hairlines, Inter + JetBrains Mono, #3b82f6 accent — rather than inventing a look.

The one thing repeated everywhere is the small grey provenance line: where a number came from, or that nothing measured it. That is the honesty rule made visible.
Start here. The nav model is the biggest unresolved design problem — 20 tabs inherited from the OpenClaw lineage, never designed as a set.
Runs has no equivalent in Todero today — per-run tracing scored 0 in the audit. This is the Paperclip / LangSmith bar: drill from a cost number to the step that caused it.
